_rateLimit.note: Rate limiting is disabled until a block named "rateLimit" (no underscore) with these fields is added to config.json. opsPerInterval: ShareDB messages (ops, subscribes, fetches, keep-alives, unrecognized messages) allowed per address per intervalLength (ms); signalsPerInterval: Webstrates actions (signals, replies, cookies) per address per interval; banDuration (ms): how long an address over either budget is banned — open connections are closed, new ones are terminated, and the budget resets when the ban lifts. Behind nginx/apache, the proxy must set X-Forwarded-For to the client address (overwriting any client-supplied value), or every user shares one budget and one ban. See middleware/dosProtectionMiddleware.js.
